title: ISAKMP: Add SHA1 verification to NAT_DETECTION_SOURCE_IP and NAT_DETECTION_DESTINATION_IP payloads
description:
These payloads contain in notification_data field the SHA1 value described in RFC7296#2.3 and the verification of this particular value was implemented to know if NAT was detected or not.

AI-Assisted: yes (GH Copilot)

**NAT_DETECTION_SOURCE_IP** -\> SHA(initiator_spi, responder_spi, source_ip, source_port)

**NAT_DETECTION_DESTINATION_IP** -\> SHA(initiator_spi, responder_spi, destination_ip, destination_port)
